svg.title: System Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: This left-to-right view follows the web client through the guarded inventory API to peer handler/service groups and shared Sequelize persistence. The MySQL boundary distinguishes inventory records from user, menu and order references shared with the application.
svg.text: OPTION B | Structured Component Architecture | Inventory Management only
API branches target peer handler/service groups; all use shared Sequelize persistence. These are logical groups within one backend application.
